test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 27 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

He has given us no reason to __be prestigious__ of him.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Be suspicious**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence is grammatically incorrect as "**prestigious**" means having a high reputation or honour, which doesn't fit the context of the sentence. (प्रतिष्ठित)
 
• "**Be suspicious**" means to doubt or question someone's actions or motives, which makes sense in the given s
